sentences.text: Today we will talk about Qatar.
Qatar is a small, rich and modern country in the Middle East.
Let's learn about it in easy English.
Where is Qatar?
Qatar is in Western Asia in the Middle East.
It is on a small peninsula in the Persian Gulf.
It shares a land border with Saudi Arabia and is close to Bahrain, United Arab Emirates and Iran across the sea.
It has desert, coastline and modern cities.
What is the capital city of Qatar?
The capital city is Doha.
Doha is a large, modern and clean city.
It has tall buildings, museums, malls and the Cornish erode by the sea.
Other towns include Al -Waqra, Al -Khor, Lusail, a new smart city.
How many people live in Qatar?
About 3 million people live in Qatar.
But most are foreign workers from other countries.
Only around 300,000 are Qatari citizens.
Qatar has people from India, Nepal, Philippines, Egypt, Bangladesh and many other countries.
What language do people speak in Qatar?
The official language is Arabic.
But many people speak English, especially in business and tourism.
Other languages spoken include Hindi, Tagalog, Urdu and Nepali.
What is the weather like in Qatar?
Qatar has a hot desert climate.
It is very hot and dry most of the year.
Summer, May to September is extremely hot over 40 degrees Celsius.
Winter, December to February is mild and pleasant.
There is little rain and the sky is usually clear.
What does Qatar look like?
Qatar has flat desert land, sand dunes, beaches in the Persian Gulf, modern buildings and tall towers, palm trees, parks and clean streets.
It is a mix of traditional desert and modern city life.
What animals live in Qatar?
In Qatar you may see camels and goats in the desert, falcons a national symbol, oryx a white desert antelope, lizards, foxes and desert birds.
In the sea, fish, crabs and dolphins, falcons are used in traditional hunting and are highly respected.
What people eat in Qatar?
Qatari food is rich, spiced and often includes rice and meat.

People eat lamb, chicken and fish, rice, dates and yogurt, vegetables, bread and spices, popular dishes, mochi booze, spiced rice with meat or fish, haris, wheat with meat, slow cooked, thyrid, bread with vegetables and broth, sambusa, fried pastry with filling, dates and Arabic coffee are served to guests as a warm welcome.
What do people drink in Qatar?
People drink.
Water, very important in the hot weather.
Carrot tea, black tea with milk and spices, Arabic coffee with cardamom, served in small cups, fruit juice, lemon mint and soft drinks.
Alcohol is not common and is mostly for tourists in special places.
What is life in Qatar?
Life in Qatar is a mix of tradition and modern living.
People enjoy spending time with family, going to malls and cafes, visiting the beach or desert, watching sports, especially football, shopping, driving and dining out.
Qataris often wear traditional clothes, men wear thobi, white robe, women wear abaya, black dress and head scarf.
What are some holidays and traditions in Qatar?
National Day, December 18th with parades and fireworks, Eid al -Fitr after Ramadan with gifts and meals, Eid al -Adha Festival of Sacrifice, Ramadan a holy month of fasting.
Qatar National Sports Day 2nd Tuesday of February, family, faith and hospitality are very important in Qatari culture.
Some fun facts about Qatar.
Qatar will host the 2027 FIBA Basketball World Cup.
It hosted the FIFA World Cup in 2022, the first in the Middle East.
Qatar is one of the richest countries in the world.
The national animal is the Arabian oryx.
The flag is white and maroon with a zigzag edge.
Now you know many things about Qatar.
You know where it is, what people speak and what they eat.
You learned about the land, traditions and modern life.
Great job!
Thank you for listening to the Slow English Podcast.
I am Emily.
